Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Backend Engineer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working alongside our HQ Integration Management and Engineering teams. Your job is to make partnerships technically real: turning an inbound partnerships inquiry into a working integration, generating and serving the affiliate and referral links that Traffic Source Partners use, and making sure the traffic those links carry lands correctly in our Web Shops and is attributed all the way through to a purchase.

You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform — link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets.

This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. If you like small, well-scoped systems that other people depend on daily, and you want to learn commerce, attribution, and payments engineering from a team that runs it at global scale, we would love to hear from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Build partner integrations

Build and maintain backend services that power Traffic Source partnerships: affiliate and referral link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution parameter pass-through, server-to-server postbacks and webhooks, and partner-facing reporting endpoints.

Take new partnerships inquiries from intake through to production — clarify the requirement with the Partnerships and BD teams, write the technical spec, implement, test, and deploy.

Integrate affiliate links with Xsolla Web Shops so partner-driven traffic is tracked end to end and attributed correctly at checkout.

Read a partner's API documentation and build against it; where a partner needs to build against us, document our side clearly and support their integration.

Tooling & data

Build internal tooling and scripts for partner onboarding, bulk link generation, performance data extraction, and payout reconciliation reporting used by the Customer Success and Partnerships teams.

Investigate and resolve attribution and tracking discrepancies together with Analytics and Customer Success — missing conversions, duplicate events, broken parameters, timing mismatches.

Add logging, metrics, and alerting so integration failures are caught by us rather than reported by a partner.

Ways of working

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

- London, UK

Available Terms

- Winter/Spring (January - May 2027)

- Summer (May - September 2027)

About the Role

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Responsibilities

- Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.

- Work cross-functionally with various teams.

- Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.

- Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.

- Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.

- Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.

- Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.

- Write for our Cloudflare blog and be featured on Cloudflare.tv sessions.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

- Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.

- Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.

- Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.

- Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.

- In office 3-5 days a week in London, UK.

Bonus Points

Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using  Cloudflare for Students.

Please note

- We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.

- We are not considering remote or part-time for either terms. This is a full-time (40hr/week internship) with in-person expectations; standard business hours are typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. You should not be enrolled in classes, which would conflict with full-time commitment.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. About the Role

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Responsibilities

- Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.

- Work cross-functionally with various teams.

- Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.

- Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.

- Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.

- Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

- Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.

- Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.

- Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.

- Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.

job_desc:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.

You should apply if…

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.

- You want to build for scale. You'll work on technology that powers physical operations at a scale most engineers never experience.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You’ll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.

- You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.

- You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.

- You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.

- You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Minimum requirements

- Currently a junior-year student on track to complete a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or Data Science between Spring/Summer/Fall 2028 or Winter 2029.

- This internship is hybrid: 3 days per week in our San Francisco, CA office. Relocation assistance is available.

Learn and Multiply: Actively participate in design reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions, leveraging our "force multiplier" culture to level up your skills and the team’s output.

What You Bring (Requirements)

-

-

Technical Curiosity: Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python , Java , JavaScript , Go ) and a strong grasp of programming/scripting fundamentals.

-

Cloud Ambition: Exposure to or a deep interest in major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS , Azure ) and modern data ecosystems.

-

DevOps Mindset: Foundational knowledge of DevOps practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation.

-

Communication Excellence: Ability to translate technical concepts for different audiences and a desire to engage in a professional services/consulting environment.

-

Startup Mentality: A strategic "builder" mindset, a sense of ownership, and the agility to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)

-

Previous internship or project experience in a Professional Services or consulting environment.

-

Experience with GenAI , MLOps , or specialized data tools (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).

-

Relevant AWS or cloud-provider certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner).

Why You'll Love It Here

-

Our Product is Our People: We live by this. We invest in people who invest in themselves. Your growth is our growth.

True Servant Leadership: Our CTO leads with a "force multiplier" philosophy. Management is here to empower you and clear roadblocks, not to micromanage. We won't ask you to do anything we're not willing to do ourselves.

Flat Organization, Real Impact: Your voice and designs will directly shape our technical roadmap and our clients' success. You'll work on the latest tech to solve real problems.

A "Learn-from-it" Culture: We're moving fast and building new things. We believe mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures.

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Get to Know the Team

GrabRentals (GR) secures vehicular supply for the Grab platform. We aim to be a partner that creates income opportunities for our driver-partners by sustainably providing them access to quality assets for use in Grab's marketplaces. We require a comprehensive fleet management system for data analysis to better unlock the value of our assets.

Get to Know the Role

You will continue developing the end-to-end fleet management system in Zoho Creator under the Fleet Manager's direction. You will collaborate with team members to keep them informed of progress and escalating complex issues to the IT Manager. In parallel, you will support the Zoho Creator–to–Salesforce migration through documentation, data/API mapping, Salesforce prototyping, and contributing to planning and design.

This is a full-time internship that runs from January 2027 onwards (6 months).

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

1) Zoho Creator Development & Optimization

You will write clean, efficient, and scalable Deluge and JavaScript code tailored to organisational needs.

You will develop dashboards and functionalities to support the growth of GrabRentals and improve operational efficiency.

You will test, debug, and document software components to meet defined quality standards.

2) Salesforce Migration & UI/UX Design

You will map process flows and design Salesforce interfaces to support clear and intuitive user journeys.

You will build Salesforce prototypes and wireframes based on technical design requirements.

You will document existing data structures and API integrations, and map them to the new Salesforce environment.

You will support transition planning through project planning, workload estimation, and technical documentation.

3) Project Execution & Testing

You will coordinate deliverables, track project timelines, provide progress updates, and escalate risks promptly.

You will lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to identify issues and verify that processes meet defined requirements.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

Currently pursue a degree in Computer Science or related field

Solid foundation in Java programming language and database design

Experience with Zoho Creator, or comparable low-code platform

Proficient in Deluge and JavaScript; experience with Java or Python

Knowledge of software development practices and methodologies

Write clean, reusable, and efficient code while observing best practices

Independent learner who excels in a VUCA environment.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer our Interns:

Comprehensive Medical Insurance: We got you covered with medical insurance plans.

Leave Entitlement: Enjoy a range of leave options including Annual Leave, Medical Leave, and Hospitalization Leave.

Flexible Work Arrangements: Benefit from a flexible work schedule that allows you to balance your academic commitments and personal life.

Community Involvement: Get involved in community service through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) programs.

Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

Timbre is an audio and video editing app for Android, live on Google Play and used by real users around the world. People use Timbre to cut, join, convert, compress and transform media on their phones, with heavier AI-powered features running on our backend.

We’re looking for an Android Developer Intern to work directly on the live app alongside the developer who owns it. You’ll start with well-scoped tasks and gradually take on larger pieces as you get comfortable with the codebase.

This is hands-on work on a real product, your changes will be reviewed, shipped and used by real users rather than staying in a prototype.

• Reproduce and fix real bugs, then verify fixes on an Android device

• Build small features and UI improvements across the editing screens

• Work on automated end-to-end test flows

• Help with localisation and product polish across our supported languages

• Test behaviour across Android versions and manufacturers and document findings

• Grow into larger feature work as the internship progresses

• An app on the Google Play Store that you’ve worked on — it can be something you published yourself, or an app from an internship or client project. Please include the link

• Working knowledge of Kotlin

• Understanding of Android fundamentals including activities, fragments, XML layouts, RecyclerView and lifecycle

• Basic Git knowledge, including branches, commits and pull requests

• An Android device you can develop and test on

• Clear written English and a willingness to debug patiently

Experience with Retrofit, media on Android, Room, WorkManager, coroutines or other Jetpack libraries is a plus.

A computer science degree, Jetpack Compose and prior professional experience are required.

For a strong intern, we would consider a full-time role at the end of the internship if an opening is available.

Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Why This Role Exists

Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building.

You'll work on two things:

Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone.

Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought.

This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions.

You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

Company: SourceIQ

Location: Remote

Duration: 3-6 months (with potential for conversion to full-time)

Compensation: Unpaid (Academic credit available)

Start Date: Flexible (Rolling applications)

*

About SourceIQ *

SourceIQ is an AI-native supplier intelligence and sourcing platform helping enterprises discover, evaluate, engage, and manage suppliers through one governed system.

We’re building our brand and product from the ground up and need creative, detail-oriented designers to help us translate complex ideas in AI, procurement, supplier intelligence, and enterprise technology into compelling visual stories.

We’re looking for a Visual & Motion Design Intern who is especially strong in Adobe Creative Suite and excited about graphic design, video editing, motion graphics, presentation design, and visual storytelling.

*

The Role *

As a Visual & Motion Design Intern, you’ll help evolve and execute SourceIQ’s visual identity across social media, video, presentations, campaigns, events, and marketing materials.

This is not just a social media graphics role. You’ll work across static and motion design, helping turn product concepts, executive ideas, company announcements, and enterprise stories into polished creative assets.

You’ll work closely with SourceIQ’s Head of Design, CEO, and marketing/product teams to translate our mission and product into visual stories that connect with enterprise procurement teams, suppliers, and industry stakeholders.

This is a portfolio-building opportunity: Your work may appear across a real B2B SaaS company’s marketing campaigns, sales materials, presentations, website, events, and social channels.

*

What You’ll Do *

*

Visual Design & Creative Production *

Social graphics: Create polished graphics for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, and other digital channels

Campaign creative: Develop visual systems for product announcements, events, thought leadership, and company initiatives

Infographics: Visualize data, statistics, product capabilities, and procurement concepts

Presentation decks: Design pitch decks, sales decks, conference presentations, and executive materials

Marketing collateral: Create one-pagers, case studies, event materials, digital assets, and supporting graphics

Website graphics: Support website and landing-page updates with custom visual assets

Template systems: Build reusable templates that improve visual consistency and production speed

*

Video Editing & Motion Design *

Edit short-form and long-form video for social media, product storytelling, events, and executive content

Create motion graphics, animated text, transitions, visual effects, and branded video elements

Produce platform-appropriate cuts for LinkedIn, Instagram, presentations, and other channels

Add captions, graphics, audio cleanup, and visual pacing to recorded content

Create animated product or feature explainers where appropriate

Develop reusable motion templates and video systems

Create compelling thumbnails and supporting promotional graphics

*

Brand Execution *

Help evolve and maintain SourceIQ’s visual brand guidelines

Translate brand principles into consistent visual systems across different formats

Help establish standards for typography, layout, imagery, motion, and graphic treatments

Maintain consistency across presentations, social media, video, web, and marketing collateral

Participate in creative reviews and iterate based on feedback from the Head of Design and leadership

*

Content Collaboration *

Executive content: Turn thought leadership ideas into compelling visual and motion content

Product storytelling: Translate product capabilities into clear visual narratives

Customer stories: Design case studies and enterprise storytelling materials

Product launches: Create announcement graphics, launch videos, and supporting campaign assets

Event promotion: Design creative for conferences, webinars, speaking engagements, and partnerships

Cross-functional collaboration: Work with design, product, marketing, sales, and leadership as projects require

*

Required Qualifications *

*

Design Skills (Must Have) *

✅ Strong working proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects

✅ Proficiency with Figma for collaborative design and visual systems

✅ Portfolio demonstrating strong visual design and creative execution

✅ Strong understanding of typography, color theory, hierarchy, layout, and composition

✅ Ability to maintain visual consistency across multiple formats

✅ Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished work

*

Video & Motion Skills (Must Have) *

✅ Experience editing video using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar

✅ Understanding of pacing, transitions, captions, audio, aspect ratios, and platform-specific video formats

✅ Ability to incorporate branded graphics and motion into video

✅ Comfortable turning raw footage or recordings into polished final content

*

Working Style *

✅ Self-directed: Can take a creative brief and move work forward without constant direction

✅ Collaborative: Comfortable receiving critique and iterating on creative work

✅ Organized: Can manage multiple creative projects and deadlines

✅ Curious: Interested in understanding the product and audience before designing

✅ Detail-oriented: Cares about visual consistency and quality

*

Nice to Have *

Advanced motion graphics experience in After Effects

Animation experience, including Lottie or web-based motion

Experience designing for B2B, SaaS, enterprise, or technology companies

Presentation design experience

Experience creating product explainers or demo videos

Photography or event-content experience

Understanding of LinkedIn and B2B visual content

Interest in AI, procurement, supply chain, or supplier ecosystems

Familiarity with design systems and reusable component/template libraries

Who Thrives in This Role

Visual storytellers who enjoy turning complex ideas into understandable creative

Designers who care equally about strong concepts and polished execution

Creative students who want real experience across graphic design, video, motion, and brand

Adobe power users who enjoy moving between Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects

Designers who want experience working across B2B campaigns, presentations, digital content, and emerging technology

Self-starters who can explore ideas independently while incorporating feedback

Detail-oriented creatives who care about typography, spacing, pacing, and consistency

*

What You’ll Learn *

*

Visual Design & Branding *

B2B brand development: How enterprise-focused brands communicate visually

Design systems: Build cohesive visual guidelines and reusable creative systems

Presentation design: Create decks for sales, fundraising, partnerships, and events

Multi-format design: Adapt concepts across social, web, video, print, and presentations

Creative direction: Learn how ideas move from brief to concept to final execution

Feedback iteration: Participate in regular creative reviews with SourceIQ’s Head of Design

*

Motion & Video *

Video storytelling: Turn raw ideas and footage into concise visual narratives

Motion systems: Build reusable animation and branded motion patterns

Platform adaptation: Design video for different channels, audiences, and aspect ratios

Executive content: Transform speaking, interviews, and thought leadership into polished content

Production workflow: Organize assets, versions, exports, and feedback efficiently

*

Startup Creative Work *

Cross-functional collaboration: Work with design, product, sales, marketing, and leadership

Brand building: Help develop a visual identity during an important stage of company growth

Creative problem-solving: Translate emerging products and complex ideas into understandable visuals

Iteration: Test ideas, receive feedback, and continuously improve creative output

*

What You’ll Help Build *

Comprehensive visual brand guidelines

Motion and video identity systems

Social media templates

Presentation deck templates

Campaign creative systems

Marketing collateral library

Consistent visual execution across channels

Brand Personality

Professional but approachable: We’re enterprise-focused, but not boring

Innovative: AI-native and technology-driven

Clear: Complex procurement ideas should feel understandable

Trustworthy: Designed for enterprise environments

Mission-driven: Creating better connections between enterprises and suppliers

*

Portfolio Requirements *

In your application, please include 4-6 examples of your work, including:

At least 2 strong visual or graphic design pieces

At least 1 video editing or motion design example

At least 1 brand identity, campaign, or visual-system example

At least 1 presentation or deck example, if available

Product/Figma work, photography, illustration, or other creative work — optional

For collaborative projects, please briefly explain what you personally contributed.

We care about design thinking, craft, typography, composition, storytelling, and demonstrated growth. Your portfolio does not need to consist entirely of professional client work—strong academic, personal, club, freelance, or experimental projects are welcome.

Portfolio can be:

PDF portfolio

Behance/Dribbble profile

Personal website

Google Drive/Dropbox folder with samples

*

Application Requirements *

Please submit the following:

Resume highlighting design, video, motion, or creative experience

Portfolio (required) — 4-6 examples following the requirements above

Short written response (150 words or less) answering:

Why does SourceIQ or this internship interest you?

Name one brand whose visual storytelling you think is exceptional and explain why.

*

Creative Exercise *

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a brief creative exercise using one SourceIQ concept such as:

Supplier discovery

AI-powered matching

Procurement intelligence

Supplier opportunity

The goal is to understand how you interpret a concept visually, not to produce finished commercial work.

*

Commitment & Expectations *

Time commitment: 15-30 hours per week (flexible based on your schedule)

Duration: Minimum 3 months, with potential to extend to 6 months

Work style: Remote-first, async-friendly with weekly creative reviews

Academic credit: Available for students whose universities offer it

Project mix: Projects may include social creative, motion/video content, presentation design, event assets, campaign materials, and brand-system work

Creative reviews: Regular feedback and prioritization with the Head of Design and team

*

Ready to Apply? *

If you’re a visual designer who loves motion, video, storytelling, and building polished creative work, we want to see your portfolio.

To apply: Send your resume, portfolio, and short written response to

abray@sourceiq.cloud

with the subject line:

“Visual & Motion Design Intern - [Your Name]”

Questions? Reach out to our team at

abray@sourceiq.cloud

SourceIQ is building the AI-powered infrastructure layer for enterprise procurement. Join us in creating the visual story of our mission.

Bariflo Cybernetics Private Limited is seeking a motivated and technically capable Mechanical Design Engineer Intern to contribute to ongoing product development and engineering projects.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks and Fusion 360, a strong understanding of engineering drawings, and practical exposure to mechanical component and assembly design.

Design and develop mechanical components, mechanisms, and assemblies using SolidWorks and Fusion 360.

Work on robotics and electromechanical product design, including structural components and mechanical mechanisms.

Design sheet-metal parts, solid components, enclosures, brackets, fixtures, and 3D-printable components.

Conduct appropriate simulation, structural analysis, and stress evaluation to verify mechanical integrity and functionality.

Participate in prototype development, testing, design validation, and iterative improvement.

Troubleshoot mechanical and design-related issues identified during prototyping, testing, or production.

Optimize designs for manufacturability, assembly, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.

Bachelor’s degree / pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Materials selection and basic materials science for mechanical components.

CAM software and CNC machining processes.

Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA).

Mechanical simulation and stress-analysis tools.

Rapid prototyping and 3D printing.

Prototype fabrication and production processes.

Mechanical integration of motors, actuators, sensors, electronics, and embedded systems.

Strong proficiency in SolidWorks and Fusion 360 for mechanical design, 3D modelling, and drafting.

Practical knowledge of:

Robotics mechanical design

Sheet-metal design

Solid-part modelling

Assembly design

3D-printing-oriented design

Good fundamental knowledge of engineering drawing, GD&T concepts, and mechanical drafting.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to understand design requirements and translate them into manufacturable mechanical solutions.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.Relevant experience may include internships, academic projects, robotics projects, product-development projects, research work, or hands-on CAD/mechanical design experience.

Internship Terms

Compensation: consolidated pay on performance

Nature of Work: Real Project-based engineering internship

Primary Tools: SolidWorks / Fusion 360

Functional Area: Mechanical R&D / Robotics / Product Development

Candidates should be prepared to work on real engineering deliverables and ongoing product-development projects and maintain proper technical documentation for their assigned work.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their updated CV/Resume along with a portfolio or samples of CAD/mechanical design work, where available, to:

human@bariflolabs.com

What you will get?

=Internship Experience Certificate issued by the company, subject to satisfactory performance and completion of assigned deliverables.

=Hands-on Industry Experience working on real-world engineering, robotics, R&D, and product development projects.

=Practical Technical Skill Development through exposure to industry-standard tools, technologies, and engineering methodologies.

=Project Portfolio Development through documented contributions to actual product development activities, subject to confidentiality requirements.

Performance-Based Recommendation Letter for deserving interns, subject to management evaluation.

Job Title: HR Recruiter

Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and results-driven HR Recruiter to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates across various roles. This position requires excellent communication skills, relationship-building abilities, and a passion for identifying top talent.

Key Responsibilities

Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, referrals, and other recruitment channels.

Screen resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on job requirements.

Conduct initial HR interviews and candidate assessments.

Schedule interviews with hiring managers and coordinate the recruitment process.

Maintain candidate databases and applicant tracking systems (ATS).

Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

Manage job postings across multiple recruitment platforms.

Coordinate offer letter issuance and onboarding activities.

Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

Track recruitment metrics and prepare hiring reports.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

1-3 years of recruitment experience (freshers with strong communication skills may also apply).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong sourcing and interviewing skills.

Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Indeed, and other job portals.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet hiring targets.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience in bulk hiring and campus recruitment.

Knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

Understanding of labor laws and hiring compliance.

Experience recruiting for technical and non-technical roles.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Number of positions filled.

Time-to-hire.

Candidate quality and retention rate.

Interview-to-selection ratio.

Hiring manager satisfaction.

Employment Type

Full-Time

Remote / Hybrid / On-site

About Atomity

Atomity is an early-stage European cloud software company building the Control layer for sovereign cloud decisions.

We help regulated organizations make better decisions about where and how their workloads run across cloud, sovereign cloud, and on-premises environments. Our platform focuses on cloud sovereignty, compliance, security, cost, sustainability, and continuous policy enforcement.

Role Description

This is a full-time,

unpaid

, remote internship.

As a Technical Recruiter Intern, you will work directly with Atomity’s founders and support the hiring of our early technical team. You will help us identify, engage, screen, and coordinate candidates for roles across frontend engineering, backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and related technical areas.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. You will not only schedule interviews. You will help build Atomity’s early recruitment process from the ground up.

Exceptional performance may lead to an opportunity for a paid, full-time role as Atomity grows.

What You Will Work On

Understand Atomity’s technical hiring requirements with the founders

Create and improve job descriptions for engineering and technical roles

Source candidates through Wellfound, LinkedIn, GitHub, university networks, technical communities, and other channels

Review applications and shortlist candidates based on predefined criteria

Conduct initial candidate screening calls

Evaluate candidates’ communication, motivation, availability, and basic role suitability

Coordinate technical interviews with the founders and engineering team

Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline and candidate database

Follow up with candidates and provide a professional candidate experience

Prepare candidate summaries and interview notes for the hiring team

Build talent pools for future frontend, backend, cloud, DevOps, and product roles

Support internship and university recruitment campaigns

Assist with employer-branding content and recruitment posts

Track basic recruitment metrics such as applications, response rates, interviews, and successful hires

Help improve Atomity’s recruitment process as the company scales

Roles You May Recruit For

Frontend Engineers using React, Next.js, and TypeScript

Backend Engineers using Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, NATS, and gRPC

Cloud and DevOps Engineers working with Docker and Kubernetes

Product, design, data, and technical internship roles

Future full-time technical and commercial positions

You are not expected to be a software engineer. However, you should be interested in learning what these roles involve and how to identify suitable candidates.

Requirements

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field

Strong written and spoken English

Genuine interest in technical recruitment and startup hiring

Good communication and interpersonal skills

Ability to communicate confidently with candidates

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Ability to handle candidate information professionally and confidentially

Willingness to learn basic technical concepts related to software engineering and cloud computing

Reliable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership

Availability to collaborate during Central European Time working hours

Nice to Have

Previous recruitment, HR, sales, customer service, or community-management experience

Experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, Wellfound, GitHub, or job portals

Basic understanding of frontend, backend, cloud, DevOps, or software engineering roles

Familiarity with terms such as React, Golang, APIs, databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud computing

Experience using Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, or an applicant-tracking system

Experience working with a startup, recruitment agency, student organization, or university placement team

Knowledge of the European or Indian technology talent market

Experience writing candidate outreach messages or job advertisements

What You Will Learn

How end-to-end technical recruitment works in a technology startup

How to understand and recruit for different engineering roles

How to source candidates beyond traditional job applications

How to conduct structured screening interviews

How to evaluate candidate suitability using hiring scorecards

How to manage a recruitment pipeline

How founders make early-stage hiring decisions

How employer branding and candidate experience affect hiring

How to build recruitment processes that can scale with a company

How a European B2B SaaS and cloud technology company builds its initial team

What We Offer

Direct collaboration with Atomity’s founders

Real recruitment responsibility rather than observation-only work

Experience helping build the early team of a European technology startup

High ownership and exposure to startup decision-making

Formal internship joining or appointment letter

Internship experience certificate after successful completion

Professional reference or recommendation based on performance

Support with future employment references where appropriate

Opportunity to build a strong portfolio of technical recruitment work

Flexible remote working environment

Potential opportunity for a paid, full-time position as Atomity scales

Who This Role Is Suitable For

This internship is suitable for someone who wants to build a career in technical recruitment, talent acquisition, startup operations, or human resources.

You should enjoy speaking with people, identifying strong candidates, maintaining organized processes, and learning how technology teams are built. You should also be comfortable working in an early-stage environment where processes are still being created and individual ownership matters.

As a Human Resources Intern supporting Recruitment, Onboarding and Employer Brand Marketing, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that shape how candidates discover, experience and join Bosch.

You’ll work closely with our North American Talent Acquisition team on a mix of strategic projects, creative initiatives and hands-on recruiting activities designed to strengthen the candidate experience and position Bosch as an employer of choice.

This internship offers exposure to multiple areas of talent acquisition, from onboarding, TA technology (applicant tracking system, AI optimization), TA compliance, onboarding, recruitment and social media marketing, content development, university and partnership engagement, and employer brand storytelling. You’ll help develop content, bring new ideas to our recruiting channels, participate in early-talent events and contribute to projects that reach candidates across North America.

You may also have opportunities to represent Bosch at offsite recruiting and university events, giving you firsthand experience connecting our employer brand with future talent.

This is a hybrid opportunity, with three onsite days per week in our Farmington Hills, MI office, creating plenty of opportunities to collaborate, build relationships and learn from HR and Talent Acquisition colleagues across Bosch.

What you'll gain

You'll gain hands-on experience across recruitment, onboarding and employer branding while building skills in project management, content development, digital marketing, university recruiting and candidate experience. You'll also have the opportunity to contribute your own ideas and take ownership of projects that directly support how Bosch attracts future talent.

What are some of the things I can expect to work on?

No two weeks will look exactly the same. Depending on current projects and priorities, you may:

Help improve the employee journey through projects focused on onboarding, employee referrals and internal talent attraction

Create resources and training content for Recruiters and Hiring Managers related to Talent Acquisition and onboarding

Turn trends and data into actionable ideas that strengthen employer branding, candidate engagement and recruiting

Support vendor relationships related on prescreening/onboarding activities

Represent Bosch at university and early-talent events, helping us build relationships with students and future candidates

Support recruitment marketing channels, including Bosch's presence on LinkedIn, Glassdoor and Indeed

Required Qualifications

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple responsibilities

Minimum 3.0 GPA

We're looking for someone who is curious, creative and excited to contribute ideas, not just complete assigned tasks.

User Experience Researcher Intern — Real-Use Testing & Product Feedback

Type: Internship — Part-time, self-paced Duration: 3–6 months Location: On campus + remote Eligibility: Current students (.edu email)

Your job is to use COTID as your tool for your own coursework and research what that’s like — as a participant, not just an observer. You claim one part of the product and test it the way a real student in your program would: every friction point, every broken promise, every moment it surprises you. Your findings are the program’s most valuable output — structured research the team can act on, not opinions. No UX background required; your field of study is the research lens.

Responsibilities

• Real-use research: make COTID your primary tool for your actual coursework — the documents, tables, and diagrams your program really requires

• Usage journal: capture evidence as you go — screenshots, recordings, and notes on what worked, what failed, what surprised you

• Research reports: turn your journal into structured findings ranked by severity × frequency — what’s broken, what’s confusing, what’s missing

• Improvement briefs: propose concrete fixes for your element, with evidence behind every claim

• Element ownership: pick one surface (document editor, canvas editor, tables, AI surfaces, onboarding) and deliver its user-experience verdict

• AI trust research: for AI features, catalog where outputs earn trust vs break it — and note whether the UI could have protected the failure

• Cross-course study: use COTID for a real task in a discipline that isn’t yours, and log what the interface assumes about a novice

• Comparison studies: record where a tool you already use handled the same job better or worse, and why

Qualifications

• Currently enrolled student — any major, any field

• You actually use digital tools heavily for your own coursework and know what “good” feels like

• Comfort recording your screen and keeping organized research notes

• Honest writing: you can deliver a negative finding plainly, in writing

• Method discipline beats credentials — you follow the protocol, you don’t freelance

Preferred

• Coursework or interest in UX, HCI, psychology, or research methods

• Daily use of a comparable tool (Notion, Obsidian, or similar) — you have opinions on why you use it

• Experience with AI assistants and an instinct for when their answers can’t be trusted

• Regular use of both macOS and Windows

COTID AI — Internship Program

Individual, campus-based, self-paced internship running 3–6 months. You claim one element of the product and one role, use COTID free on your real coursework for the full program, and every finding you ship feeds the program — your campus work is the work.

Work

• Core loop: real usage → captured evidence → improvement brief → feedback report on your element

• Deliverables reviewed asynchronously by a mentor against a shared rubric

• Your discipline’s lens makes your findings different from every other intern’s

What you earn

• Free COTID for the full 3–6 month program

• Certificate of completion

• Opportunity to continue into an official cohort program

• Not continuing into the cohort? Option to purchase COTID at a discount at the end of the program

• Portfolio-grade deliverables: a usage journal, a severity-ranked research report, and an evidence-backed improvement brief
